purpose.zh: 团身俄挺之后的下一级，练肩和腹部撑起整个身体
purpose.en: The next step after the tuck planche: shoulders and belly hold your whole body up.

text.zh: 手臂锁直，肩膀往前倾过手，腿伸直往两边打开
text.en: Arms locked, shoulders well past your hands, legs straight and wide

text.zh: 手把地推开，肩膀往下压、背微微拱，屁股夹紧往下收。
text.en: Push the floor away, shoulders down, upper back slightly round, squeeze your glutes and tuck your hips.

text.zh: 身体和地面平，屁股跟肩一样高，重量压在手掌上，别往脚那边掉。
text.en: Body level with the floor, hips as high as your shoulders, weight over your palms, not sliding back.

text.zh: 手指往两边转开一点，手腕会舒服些；撑不住就先单腿伸出去。
text.en: Turn your fingers out to ease your wrists; if it's too much, extend one leg first.

commonErrors.zh: 屁股太高或者塌腰，身体不平
commonErrors.en: Hips too high or a sagging back, so your body isn't level.

commonErrors.zh: 肩膀前倾不够，重心落在脚那边
commonErrors.en: Not leaning your shoulders far enough, so your weight falls back toward your feet.

cautions.zh: 手腕、肩前侧疼就退回团身版
cautions.en: If your wrists or front of the shoulders hurt, go back to the tuck version.

thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
